report: hi. my receptionist booked mrs aisha for 3 march 2025 by accident (we meant 2027) and the system just saved it?? no warning nothing. it should not let us book in the past right. we are sunrise clinic

plan.understanding: A Sunrise Clinic receptionist booked an appointment for patient Aisha on 3 March 2025, a date in the past, and the app saved it without any warning or error.
plan.expected: The app should refuse to book an appointment on a past date. It should show an error such as 'appointment date cannot be in the past' and not save the booking.
plan.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login and log in with email {{account1_email}} and password {{account1_password}}. Open the page for booking a new appointment. Select the patient named Aisha, set the date to 2025-03-03 and the time to 10:00, then click the button to book or save. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the app shows an error saying the date is in the past and the appointment was not saved.

kane.reason: Final verification failed: "The app shows an error saying the date is in the past and the appointment was not saved."
kane.summary:
The form did not reject the 3 March 2025 appointment date. After booking, the patient page shows the 03 Mar 2025 · 10:00 appointment, and no past-date error is shown.
Reject dates before the current date when booking, keep the user on the form, and clearly state that the appointment was not saved.
evidence: http_error_response: POST http://127.0.0.1:8001/appointments/new -> 303
evidence: objective_contradiction: The appointment was not saved.

judgement.explanation: The browser agent logged in, booked Aisha Rahman for 3 March 2025 at 10:00, and the app saved it without any warning. The appointment then showed on her patient page, so the app does accept bookings in the past, just as the clinic reported.

ticket.title: Appointments can be booked on past dates with no error
steps: Log in to the clinic app as a Sunrise Clinic user
Go to Appointments and click '+ Book appointment'
Select patient 'Aisha Rahman'
Set the date to 2025-03-03 and the time to 10:00
Click 'Book appointment'
ticket.expected: The booking is refused, the user stays on the form, and an error such as 'Appointment date cannot be in the past' is shown. Nothing is saved.
ticket.actual: The form is accepted and the user is redirected (POST /appointments/new returns 303). The patient page then shows a saved appointment on 03 Mar 2025 · 10:00, and no error or warning appears.
